messages:
leo: Heads-up: customer reported the HSM/PKCS11 Terraform module docs don't mention socket perms or systemd pre-starts. They also wanted a tiny Ansible snippet for sealed installs and a short GCP firewall example for KMS egress. Can we patch the quickstart and add an example?

maya: Yep. I'll add an anchor alias in the Private quickstart so the external link doesn't break if we refactor headings. Also add a 1-line migration tip in the migration guide about using stable IDs or aliases.

zara: For the snippets, propose: (A) systemd ExecStartPre example for PKCS11 socket ownership, (B) Ansible task to set ownership + perms, (C) gcloud one-liner to open KMS egress to a CIDR. Keeping each tiny so users can copy-paste.

leo: Please include a short note about preferring unix transport for local PKCS11 daemons and tcp for remote KMS/HSM, one sentence each. Users keep asking which to pick.

maya: Draft PR ready: will add anchor alias, a 3-line Terraform example calling the HSM module with a short comment about socket creation, and a compact migration note. Opening PR after zara adds snippets.

zara: Snippets (to include in PR):
```
# systemd ExecStartPre (example)
ExecStartPre=/bin/chown redwood-installer:installer /var/run/pkcs11.sock
ExecStartPre=/bin/chmod 660 /var/run/pkcs11.sock
```
```
# Ansible task (minimal)
- name: Ensure pkcs11 socket ownership
  file:
    path: /var/run/pkcs11.sock
    owner: redwood-installer
    group: installer
    mode: '0660'
```
```
# gcloud firewall allow egress to KMS CIDR (example)
gcloud compute firewall-rules create allow-kms-egress --direction=EGRESS --destination-ranges=10.0.0.0/8 --allow=all
```

maya: Added the unix vs tcp single-sentence guidance to the quickstart: "Use unix transport when the KMS/PKCS11 daemon runs on the same host (air-gapped installs); use tcp when KMS is remote or managed (ensure mTLS)."

leo: Nice and concise. Can you also add a 1-line SELinux hint: `chcon -t container_file_t /var/run/pkcs11.sock` marked optional? Many customers on RHEL need it.

zara: Added SELinux hint as optional. Opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1215 - includes anchor alias, TF/HSM micro example, systemd + Ansible + gcloud snippets, SELinux hint, and migration tip.

docbot: netlify-preview: https://deploy-preview-1215--docs.redwood.ai - link checks flagged 1 anchor which PR adds an alias for.

maya: Preview looks good, snippets render and anchor alias prevents breakage. CI green. Merging in a few.

leo: Merged. Thanks y'all 389 Closing thread.
